Passively grants 20 Airborne Effectiveness to <primary/>Primary Weapons.

Grants the following benefits while a <primary/>Primary Weapon is readied and not Aiming Down Sights:
• 30 Mobility
• 5 Range and 30? Stability
• 70% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 2 degrees increased Precision Aim Cone Angle
• 20% increased Aim Assist and Damage Falloff Distance

<yellow DMT />, <yellow Last Word />, and <yellow Tommy's Matchbook /> are uniquely tuned and do not receive as significant of a benefit.

<primary/>Primary Weapon Kills grant Class Ability Energy based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
Minors: 34% | Elites and higher: 100% | Players: 20%

#ChunkEnergyUnaffected

At full Class Ability energy, scoring multiple <primary/>Primary Weapon Kills within 6 seconds of each grants an additional Class Ability Charge. Maximum of 2 extra charges.

Activation progress granted by <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
Minors: 34% | Elites and higher: 100% | Players: 100%
